boxes.meaning: where someone or animal was born

english.meaning: where someone or animal was born
english.note: This is the all-purpose casual Cantonese way to refer to where someone or an animal was born.

examples.english: I can't remember where their birthplace is.
examples.traditional: 我唔記得佢出世嘅地方喺邊。
